scope: Complete selected Cream arrangement on an unexpanded 64 KiB C64, with two oscillator PCM lanes and one native SID program.

startup_loader.scope: Startup only. Original entry and high code restored before playback; score, instruments and playback addresses unchanged.

program.SID2_event_format: Three-byte little-endian count and descriptor ID; zero count terminates. Four parallel tables supply cursor/end addresses.

score.transients: Offsets15/22 zero each tick; only bits0/1 of23 zero each tick; gain bits persist.

limitations: Original C1 is included only in its existing introduction allocation; subsequent C1 chords remain omitted.
SID1 keeps the existing pulse and arpeggio approximations and on/off volume policy.
SID2 has approximately 977 Hz audio bandwidth; its C1 introduction now uses original sampled instrument data.
Screen-on operation and physical SID have not been verified.

all.sid2_clock: Global phases0/2 at SID3 indices0mod4/2mod4; never reset at50Hz. Phase0 CTRL17@+35,CTRL9@+41; phase2 high@+37,CTRL1@+43. Lastphase0 fullychecked.
all.scope: Every native SID3 input/prefix and SID2 phase write, global126/504cycle clocks, startup neutral state, every SID1 score value and poststartup exact slot, complete frame counter and available runtime error counters. Digital correctness does not establish timbre, balance or physical SID fidelity. Absolute startup phase is reported pending calibration.

ring.scope: Actual unmodified native execution. Every read has the correct sequential generation, including repeated neutral values. This proves causality beyond matching SID register values.

cpu.scope: Unmodified automatic-activation PRG. Every NMI/boundary, exact buffer length and126cycle latch clock checked. RLE fills meet the actual NMI shadow-read deadline; no foreground wait/pointer-swap gate. Costs include hardware entry/RTI and JSR/RTS as stated; final nonreturning NMI is excluded from averages. Ring generations and audio quality require separate proofs.
cpu.c3_background_control_scope: Includes active queue/boundary guards and branches between consecutive C3 calls. RLE fills and intervening idle waits excluded; final exit into each idle wait is not charged.

attribution.scope: Exact non-overlapping wall-cycle partition of the unchanged program, excluding startup and terminal shutdown. NMI cycles are removed from every foreground interval. Main-control/busy-wait residual is not a claim that all those cycles can meet an arbitrary new deadline.
